metadata.description: FFT base stats by unit type. Values are fixed-point (raw << 14)
metadata.source: FFT PSX — ROM-derived VALUES, transcribed by hand. There is no parser.
metadata.provenance: hand-authored in root ADR-0001's sense, and the classification is deliberate rather than a leftover (register step 15). The five numbers per unit type are the disc's, but NOTHING in tools/ reads them out: no generator exists, and a bounded search of SCUS_942.21 and BATTLE.BIN for the three rows as contiguous 32-bit LE, as raw>>14 bytes and as raw>>13 bytes found no table in any of the six encodings tried. That is consistent with ADR-0001's ISO CODE class -- an immediate in .text that a hex grep of the disc cannot find -- but it does not prove it, and locating the instruction was not attempted. So this file cannot be gitignored the way an iso-data artifact is: it is committed because nothing can rebuild it, which is exactly what ADR-0001 says a COMMITTED provenance means.
